paragraphs: This repository contains the developer playground/workstation environment for the MIT Probabilistic Computing Project probcomp/notebook image. It contains the full probcomp software stack in addition to enabling active development on the various repositories including bayeslite, cgpm, crosscat, iventure and venturecxx.
